text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 61 vials of sugammadex 100 mg/mL 5 mL (14.5 days on hand at 4.2 vials/day). Corvale East holds 100 vials (30.7 days on hand at 3.3 vials/day). No national shortage is declared.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show sugammadex is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. Proactive sourcing is warranted to prevent future gaps given limited days on hand at General. All identified manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Aspiro Pharma Limited, VAI 2023-08-11) as primary vendor; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Inc. (Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited-FTO9, VAI 2024-05-17) as secondary vendor; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Somerset Therapeutics, LLC (Solupharm Pharmazeutische Erzeugnisse GmbH, VAI 2022-07-29) as tertiary vendor; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to request manufacturing site details for Accord Healthcare Inc. and B. Braun Medical Inc. to complete vendor qualification; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
